events.description: DELIVERED AND VERIFIED 2026-11-10 (storypole 5e95032). The fixture builds a suite with a declared member, gives each store its own ticket under its own prefix, and opens from inside the member: the member key must resolve and the suite key must not, while opening from the root must resolve the suite key. A workspace-first read fails the second assertion while still succeeding, which is the silent half the ticket records. PROVENANCE, stated because it is wrong and GB-313 exists for exactly this: the receipt below says repo benchwork and chain benchwork, because this ticket scope resolves to a benchwork crate, while the test it asked for landed in storypole. The storypole chain that actually compiled and ran the new test is the one from GB-242 in the same batch, not this receipt. That mismatch is now visible in the coverage line `storypole show` prints rather than silent, which is the improvement GB-313 bought.
